title: In Vitro Anticancer Activity of Methanolic Extract of Justicia adhatoda Leaves with Special Emphasis on Human Breast Cancer Cell Line.
authors: Kumar, Sonu; Singh, Rajveer; Dutta, Debrupa; Chandel, Shivani; Bhattacharya, Arka; Ravichandiran, Velayutham; Sukla, Soumi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Justicia adhatoda叶提取物的体外抗癌活性，仅含NF-kappaB的简单分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Natural products are being targeted as alternative anticancer agents due to their non-toxic and safe nature. The present study was conducted to explore the in vitro anticancer potential of Justicia adhatoda (J. adhatoda) leaf extract. The methanolic leaf extract was prepared, and the phytochemicals and antioxidant potential were determined by LCMS analysis and DPPH radical scavenging assay, respectively. A docking study performed with five major alkaloidal phytoconstituents showed that they had a good binding affinity towards the active site of NF-kappaB. Cell viability assay was carried out in five different cell lines, and the extract exhibited the highest cytotoxicity in MCF-7, a breast cancer cell line. Extract-treated cells showed a significant increase in nitric oxide and reactive oxygen species production. Cell cycle analysis showed an arrest in cell growth at the Sub-G0 phase. The extract successfully inhibited cell migration and colony formation and altered mitochondrial membrane potential. The activities of superoxide dismutase and glutathione were also found to decrease in a dose-dependent manner. The percentage of apoptotic cells was found to increase in a dose-dependent manner in MCF-7 cells. The expressions of caspase-3, Bax, and cleaved-PARP were increased in extract-treated cells. An increase in the expression of NF-kappaB was found in the cytoplasm in extract-treated cells. J. adhatoda leaf extract showed a potential anticancer effect in MCF-7 cells.
abstract_zh: 天然产物因其无毒、安全的特性，正被作为替代性抗癌药物进行靶向研究。本研究旨在探索Justicia adhatoda（J. adhatoda）叶片提取物的体外抗癌潜力。制备了甲醇叶片提取物，并通过LCMS分析和DPPH自由基清除实验分别测定了其植物化学成分和抗氧化潜力。与五种主要生物碱类植物成分进行的对接研究表明，它们对NF-kappaB活性位点具有良好的结合亲和力。在五种不同细胞系中进行了细胞活力测定，提取物在乳腺癌细胞系MCF-7中表现出最高的细胞毒性。提取物处理的细胞显示出一氧化氮和活性氧产生显著增加。细胞周期分析显示细胞生长在Sub-G0期被阻滞。提取物成功抑制了细胞迁移和集落形成，并改变了线粒体膜电位。超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽的活性也呈剂量依赖性下降。在MCF-7细胞中，凋亡细胞百分比呈剂量依赖性增加。提取物处理的细胞中caspase-3、Bax和cleaved-PARP的表达增加。在提取物处理的细胞质中，NF-kappaB的表达增加。J. adhatoda叶片提取物在MCF-7细胞中显示出潜在的抗癌效果。
